name: codex-agents
description: A side pane «Codex»: the OpenAI Codex runs working now and the last ones that finished, each in its own block with a status word (RUNNING, SILENT, DONE, FAILED and why), what it is doing or its result, and how fresh the data is; the plan's limits on top; read from Codex's own session files, no model calls

taskDirs.title: Wrapper folders
taskDirs.description: Absolute (or ~/) folders where wrapper scripts keep codex-<id>.session, codex-<id>.jsonl or codex-<id>-review.jsonl: a run whose thread id one of them names is labelled by <id> instead of its prompt's first line.

windowHours.title: Window, hours
windowHours.description: Outer bound: a run whose session file has not changed for this many hours is never listed, even with no newer runs.

staleMinutes.title: Silent after, minutes
staleMinutes.description: An unfinished run whose session file has not changed for this long is shown as SILENT; after an hour (or 3× this, whichever is more) it counts as FAILED (no events).

sessionsDir.title: Codex sessions folder
sessionsDir.description: Where Codex writes its rollout files; '' means ~/.codex/sessions.
